title: Walk through a system architecture
summary: Giải thích luồng hệ thống, ranh giới, failure path và trade-off bằng tiếng Anh dễ theo dõi.

sections.title: Order pipeline
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Client → API gateway → order service → event broker → inventory and payment consumers. The gateway authenticates and routes the request. In one transaction, the order service validates and records the order plus an outbox entry; an outbox publisher then sends the event to the broker. Delivery is at-least-once, so a duplicate event is possible and both consumers use the event ID to process idempotently. Inventory reserves stock and payment authorizes the charge independently. If only one consumer succeeds, the order status is partial; it becomes complete only after both report success. The API returns accepted before downstream completion, reducing request wait but making status pending or partial. Failed message deliveries are retried twice; after both retries are exhausted, the message enters a dead-letter queue for operator inspection before replay.

expressions.meaning: Introduce a component and its responsibility together.
expressions.example: A request first enters the gateway, which authenticates and routes it.

expressions.meaning: Signal a clear transition between stages.
expressions.example: Once the outbox entry is committed, the publisher sends the event.

expressions.meaning: Connect an architectural benefit to its operational cost.
expressions.example: This improves request latency, but it requires idempotent consumers and status tracking.
alternatives: The benefit is ___; the trade-off is ___.

exercises.question: Câu nào giúp người nghe theo dõi luồng tốt nhất?
options: There are many services, and each one stores its own data.
Once the outbox publisher sends the event, two consumers process inventory and payment independently.
It is an event-driven design, so services react to events as they arrive.
Many services take part in this design, and each of them reacts to events in its own time and in its own way.
correctAnswer: Once the outbox publisher sends the event, two consumers process inventory and payment independently.
exercises.explanation: Transition chỉ rõ thời điểm, component và hành động thay vì chỉ gắn nhãn architecture.

exercises.question: Why must both consumers be idempotent?
options: At-least-once delivery can send the same event more than once.
The gateway authenticates every request twice.
A partial order is always replayed from the browser, so each consumer sees it again.
correctAnswer: At-least-once delivery can send the same event more than once.
exercises.explanation: Idempotent handling prevents a duplicate delivery from reserving stock or authorizing payment twice.

exercises.question: What status should the order have if inventory succeeds but payment has not succeeded?
exercises.explanation: The evidence says completion requires both independent consumers to report success.

performanceTask.title: Explain an architecture flow
performanceTask.scenario: Một kỹ sư mới cần hiểu request flow và cách hệ thống xử lý failure.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, giải thích sơ đồ bằng tiếng Anh mà chưa xem model hoặc chunk.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, giải thích bằng tiếng Anh từ entry point đến consumers; nêu responsibility, outbox handoff, at-least-once delivery với idempotent handling, async trade-off, partial status và message-delivery failure path.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Let me walk through the request. The gateway authenticates and routes it to the order service. In one transaction, the service records the order and an outbox entry; an outbox publisher then sends the event to the broker. Because delivery is at least once, inventory and payment consumers use the event ID idempotently. They run independently, so the order can be partial when only one succeeds and becomes complete only after both succeed. The API can return accepted before that work finishes, which shortens request time but means the client initially sees pending or partial status. If message delivery fails, it is retried twice. After both retries, the message enters a dead-letter queue for inspection before replay; replay is safe because consumers deduplicate the event. This improves response latency but adds status tracking, duplicate-delivery handling and operational recovery.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, giải thích pipeline ảnh mới; dùng signposting rõ và ưu tiên criterion cần sửa.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Trong 90–120 giây và không xem model/chunks, giải thích pipeline upload file từ facts mới.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Trong 90–120 giây, từ review brief mới, walk through happy path, trade-off và failure path.

artifacts.title: Order flow
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. The gateway authenticates and routes the request. The order service records the order and an outbox entry in one transaction; an outbox publisher sends the event. Delivery is at-least-once, so inventory and payment use the event ID idempotently. They run independently: one success produces partial status, and both successes produce complete status. The API returns accepted before downstream completion, improving request latency while requiring pending or partial status. Failed message deliveries retry twice, then the message enters a dead-letter queue for inspection before replay.

artifacts.title: Image flow
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. The upload API validates image metadata and stores the object. A queue then gives the resize worker the job. Returning after storage improves upload latency, but the preview can remain pending for up to 30 seconds. The worker retries twice; poison jobs enter a quarantine queue for operator inspection.

artifacts.title: Upload flow
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. The browser uses a signed upload to write directly to object storage. A storage event enters the scan queue, and an antivirus worker marks the file clean. Direct upload reduces API load, but the download remains locked while scanning is pending. A scan timeout sends the file to manual review.

artifacts.title: Notification flow
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. The service publishes one event to a notification topic. Email and SMS consumers format and send each channel independently. This isolates channel failures, but delivery is eventual and requires queue operations. Each consumer enforces its channel rate limit; exhausted retries enter a dead-letter queue and trigger an operator alert.
